description: What happened between reconciliations, April to August 2026 (fictional). Replayed by the history loader in time order between monthly cycles. Invoices are referenced by vendor GSTIN + invoice number as booked.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.note: Checked with stores: Godavari Steel invoice INV/26-27/0021 was booked as '21' by the stores clerk. Same invoice, same amount.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: Called Sri Balaji Traders about invoices SBT/2026/0031 and SBT/2026/0038 missing from the April 2026 GSTR-2B.

events.author: P. Venkatesh, Sri Balaji Traders
events.summary: Sri Balaji Traders explained they upload late-month invoices to GSTR-1 after the customer pays, so they go into the next month's return. Promised both invoices would appear in the May 2026 GSTR-2B.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: E-mailed Nandi Electricals: invoice NEL/7710 is reported in GSTR-1 at Rs 2,10,000 taxable against the agreed Rs 1,96,000 (Rs 2,520 ITC difference).

events.author: A. Gowda, Nandi Electricals
events.summary: Nandi Electricals confirmed NEL/7710 was billed at list price and promised a credit note for Rs 14,000 in their May 2026 GSTR-1.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: E-mailed Sri Balaji Enterprises: invoice SBE-2190 is reported at Rs 1,86,000 taxable in GSTR-1 against Rs 1,68,000 in our books (Rs 3,240 ITC difference).

events.author: K. Ramesh, Sri Balaji Enterprises
events.summary: Sri Balaji Enterprises agreed the volume discount was missed and promised a credit note for Rs 18,000 in their May 2026 GSTR-1.

events.headline: Possible timing difference: both earlier missing invoices from this vendor appeared in the next GSTR-2B (2 of 2, April 2026).
events.next_step: Check the June 2026 GSTR-2B before sending a reminder; review if still unmatched.

events.headline: Possible timing difference; only one earlier case from this vendor (April), and it is still open.
events.next_step: Wait for the June 2026 GSTR-2B; send a reminder if the invoice is still missing.

events.headline: IGST reported on an intra-state freight invoice; no earlier history for this vendor.
events.next_step: Ask Metro Logistics to amend the tax head to CGST + SGST in their next GSTR-1.

decision.note: Sent the follow-up with the correct place of supply (36) so they can also fix their billing software.

events.headline: The last amount difference from this vendor (SBE-2190, April) was settled by a credit note.
events.next_step: Expect a credit note in the next GSTR-2B.

decision.note: Here the vendor under-reported (Rs 1,24,200 in GSTR-1 vs Rs 1,42,000 booked). A credit note cannot fix that; asked them to amend.

events.headline: Same pattern as April: the invoice number was booked without the vendor's prefix.
events.next_step: Confirm it is the same invoice and accept the format difference.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: E-mailed Metro Logistics: MLS/1043 (freight within Telangana) is reported with IGST; it should be CGST + SGST. Place of supply is 36.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: E-mailed Sri Balaji Enterprises: SBE-2211 is reported at Rs 1,24,200 taxable in GSTR-1 against Rs 1,42,000 on the invoice.

events.author: K. Ramesh, Sri Balaji Enterprises
events.summary: Sri Balaji Enterprises admitted a keying error and promised to amend SBE-2211 in their June 2026 GSTR-1.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: Follow-up 1: e-mailed Kaveri Packaging about KPL/0456 (April, Rs 8,640 ITC) and KPL/0502 (May, Rs 12,600 ITC) missing from GSTR-2B and asked them to file. No reply.

events.author: K. Srikanth, Metro Logistics
events.summary: Letter from Metro Logistics acknowledging IGST was reported on MLS/1043 by mistake and promising to amend it in their June 2026 GSTR-1 (due 11 July 2026).

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: Follow-up 2: called Kaveri Packaging about three unfiled invoices; the accounts contact was unavailable, message left for R. Manjunath.

events.author: R. Manjunath, Kaveri Packaging
events.summary: Letter from Kaveri Packaging blaming a change in their accounts team and promising in writing to file KPL/0456, KPL/0502 and KPL/0547 (total ITC Rs 34,740) in GSTR-1 by 20 July 2026.

events.headline: Possible timing difference: 3 of 3 earlier missing invoices from this vendor appeared in the next GSTR-2B (April, May).
events.next_step: Check the July 2026 GSTR-2B before sending a reminder; review if still unmatched.

events.headline: Potential ITC risk: two earlier Kaveri invoices are still missing (Rs 21,240) and the June follow-up got no reply.
events.next_step: Do not claim this ITC until it appears; review the invoice, contract and payment status before deciding.

events.headline: Same tax-head error as MLS/1043 in May, which Metro amended after one follow-up and kept its written promise.
events.next_step: Send one follow-up asking for an amendment in the July 2026 GSTR-1.

events.headline: Nandi settled the April difference on NEL/7710 by credit note within a month.
events.next_step: Ask Nandi for a credit note for the Rs 6,500 difference; expect it in the next GSTR-2B.

events.headline: 2 of 2 earlier format differences from Godavari Steel were confirmed typos.
events.next_step: Confirm it is the same invoice and accept the format difference.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: E-mailed Metro Logistics: MLS/1077 is again reported with IGST instead of CGST + SGST.

events.author: K. Srikanth, Metro Logistics
events.summary: Metro Logistics apologised and promised to amend MLS/1077 in their July 2026 GSTR-1.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: E-mailed Nandi Electricals: NEL/7788 reported at Rs 1,65,000 taxable against Rs 1,58,500 agreed.

events.author: A. Gowda, Nandi Electricals
events.summary: Nandi Electricals promised credit note NEL/CN/038 for Rs 6,500 in their July 2026 GSTR-1.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.summary: Follow-up 3: e-mailed Kaveri Packaging that the 20 July filing date in their letter of 6 July had passed and the three invoices were still not in GSTR-2B. No reply.

events.headline: Potential ITC risk: Kaveri broke its written promise to file by 20 July 2026; three earlier invoices remain unfiled.
events.next_step: Do not claim this ITC until it appears; review the invoice, contract and payment status before deciding.

events.headline: 3 of 3 earlier format differences from Godavari Steel were confirmed typos; approved rule FORMAT_ONLY applies.
events.next_step: Auto-resolve as a format difference (audited, reversible).

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.note: Kaveri Packaging did not keep its written promise to file by 20 July 2026. Escalated to CFO Srinivas Reddy.

events.author: Lakshmi Prasad
events.note: ITC of Rs 8,640 on KPL/0456 reversed in the July 2026 GSTR-3B after four months without filing. Approved by Srinivas Reddy (CFO).
